facts.fact: 广播开场宣布风暴已正式移入海面，主持人感叹大自然的威力。
facts.anchor: We have good news. The storm has officially moved out to sea! What a show it put on for us, right?

facts.fact: 虽风雨已停但仍需遵守安全预防措施，在外的人应搭摆渡车回别墅。
facts.anchor: there are still some safety precautions we need to follow. Anyone still out and about should find a shuttle

facts.fact: 所有港口设施关闭至次日早晨，以便清洁队夜间清理残骸。
facts.anchor: We’re closing all harbor facilities until the morning so cleanup crews can work overnight to remove any debris.

facts.fact: 岛上部分地区停电，主要在 Tranquil Cove 一侧。
facts.anchor: we do have some power issues on certain parts of the island, mainly on the Tranquil Cove side.

facts.fact: 主持人调侃停电让大人可烛光独处，称父母们都安然无恙。
facts.anchor: there’s nothing more romantic for grown-ups than being alone with each other by candlelight.
